# Leeds Mind

> Leeds Mind provides comprehensive mental health support, counselling, peer support, and employment services across Leeds and West Yorkshire.

Leeds Mind is a local mental health charity offering a range of community-based services including crisis support, counselling, befriending, social prescribing, and specialized employment support through WorkPlace Leeds. The organization serves diverse populations including young people, older adults, and individuals seeking workplace mental health support.

## Key Topics

- mental health support
- counselling services

## Crisis & Immediate Support

- [Need help now - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/need-help-now): Emergency mental health crisis support and immediate helplines for Leeds

## Core Services

- [Services - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services): Overview of Leeds Mind services including counselling, peer support, employment
- [Counselling - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/counselling): Person-centred counselling services for mental health difficulties in Leeds
- [Peer Support - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/peer-support): Peer-led support groups and online workshops for mental wellbeing
- [Peer support Transformation: One-to-one professional referral - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/peer-support/one-to-one-professional-referral): Professional referral pathway for one-to-one peer support services
- [Live Well Leeds - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/live-well-leeds): Live Well Leeds: community-based mental health support services
- [Social Prescribing - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/social-prescribing): Linking Leeds: free city-wide social prescribing wellbeing service

## Specialized Support Programs

- [Support for Young People - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/young-people): Youth in Mind: mental health support for ages 10-25 in Leeds
- [Leeds Mind Befriending Service - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/befriending-leeds): One-to-one befriending service for older adults and loneliness support
- [Arts & Minds - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/creative-wellbeing-leeds-arts-minds): Arts & Minds Network: creative wellbeing and befriending partnerships in Leeds

## Employment & Workplace Support

- [Workplace Leeds - Employment Support - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/workplace-leeds): WorkPlace Leeds: employment support and job retention services
- [Employment Support - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/workplace-leeds/employment-support): IPS employment placement and job coaching for mental health recovery
- [Job Retention Support - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/workplace-leeds/job-retention-support): Job retention and return-to-work support with mental health specialists
- [Courses and Workshops - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/services/workplace-leeds/courses-and-workshops): WorkPlace Leeds peer-led courses and workshops for job retention
- [Help for Employers - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/help-for-employers): Employer support, mental health training, and workplace wellbeing programs
- [Training - Leeds Mind](https://www.leedsmind.org.uk/help-for-employers/training): Mental health awareness and first aid training courses for employers
